ops.title: test_an_incident_closes…[OK-True-fix-True] red on cc-skills main
ops.premise: The incident-close test's OK-True-fix-True case fails on main e33cee5db and on #4953's head c2b30f7cb alike, after #4973 patched its thread window: the watch writes no thread record for order o3. First evidence: run 43434096973, and a local run of that one test on an archive of main.
